subject.title: fix(anthropic): expose native effort ladder for mandatory-adaptive Claude 5 on claude-cli

question: Should `claude-cli` Fable/Mythos inherit the direct Anthropic full ladder with `high` default, despite Mythos lacking direct live proof in the PR body?
rationale: This is a deliberate compatibility/default behavior change for existing configured sessions, and the remaining uncertainty is maintainer acceptance of that upgrade behavior rather than a mechanical code defect.

options.title: Accept corrected CLI profile
options.body: Land after exact-head CI review, accepting that Claude CLI Fable/Mythos sessions move from off-only to native effort selection.

options.title: Keep ladder but narrow default
options.body: Expose the supported levels but choose an explicit `claude-cli` default such as `off` if maintainers do not want upgrades to start passing `--effort high`.

options.title: Pause for Mythos proof
options.body: Hold or narrow the Mythos part until someone with access verifies the same effort ladder live.

recommendation.title: Accept corrected CLI profile
recommendation.body: Land after exact-head CI review, accepting that Claude CLI Fable/Mythos sessions move from off-only to native effort selection.

likelyOwner.reason: Most directly tied to the current thinking-profile gate and recent Claude effort/profile history.
